claims.claim_text: Planet operates over 100 satellites (designed, built, launched and operated), including SkySat and Pelican high-resolution satellites and a hyperspectral Tanager satellite, generating a daily-revisit imagery archive of over 3,000 images per point on Earth's landmass.
claims.extraction_quote: we have designed, built, launched, and operated hundreds of satellites... To collect this powerful data set, we design, build and operate over one hundred satellites.

claims.claim_text: In December 2025 Planet entered a multi-year low 9-figure (~$100M+) commercial satellite-services agreement with the Swedish Armed Forces (SwAF) to build and operate a constellation of Pelican high-resolution satellites owned by SwAF.
claims.extraction_quote: In December 2025, Planet entered into a multi-year low 9-figure commercial agreement with the Swedish Armed Forces ("SwAF"). Pursuant to the agreement, Planet will build and operate a constellation of Pelican high resolution satellites that will be owned by SwAF.

claims.claim_text: Planet generated $180.2M of Defense & Intelligence revenue in FY2026 (up from $116.3M in FY2025), implying material U.S. federal contract presence; total FY2026 revenue $307.7M with two customers at 13% and 12% of revenue.
claims.extraction_quote: Defense Intelligence ... 180,232 ... 116,281 ... 94,555 ... Total revenue 307,727. For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, two customers accounted for 13% and 12% of revenue.

claims.claim_text: Planet is a NASA Communications Services Project (CSP) subcontractor (to two prime providers) with aggregate $40.5M funding; $30.4M received as of Jan 31, 2026. Lists Telesat and SES as named partners for CSP.
claims.extraction_quote: The agreements... provide for the Company to receive aggregate funding of $40.5 million... the Company had received a total of $30.4 million... in connection with the NASA CSP... our partnerships with Telesat and SES as part of the NASA Communications Services Project.

claims.claim_text: Planet has a patent portfolio covering novel spacecraft features (satellites, imaging, constellation operations).
claims.extraction_quote: Our IP portfolio includes patents covering novel features of our spacecraft, trademarks identifying our company and various products, copyright ownership of the imagery archive, and trade secrets related to manufacturing and operations.

claims.claim_text: Planet's corporate headquarters in San Francisco (~71,280 sq ft) houses ALL satellite manufacturing, testing, and R&D; manufacturing is also being expanded in Germany.
claims.extraction_quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in San Francisco, California, and consists of approximately 71,280 square feet, in which all satellite manufacturing, testing, and R&D occurs... expanding manufacturing operations in Germany.

claims.claim_text: FY2026 net loss of $246.9M (vs $123.2M in FY2025) and accumulated deficit of $1,449.9M, but positive operating cash flow of $134.4M, $640M in cash + short-term investments, and a fresh $460M 0.50% convertible due 2030 (Sept 2025).
claims.extraction_quote: net losses of $246.9 million, $123.2 million and $140.5 million for our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024... accumulated deficit of $1,449.9 million... cash provided by Operating activities $134,362... $460.0 million in aggregate principal amount of 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030.

claims.claim_text: Remaining performance obligations of $852.4M as of Jan 31, 2026 (a multi-year backlog including satellite services agreements and multi-year imagery licensing).
claims.extraction_quote: The Company's remaining performance obligations were $852.4 million as of January 31, 2026. The Company expects to recognize approximately 34% of the remaining performance obligations within the next 12 months.
